Package com.bupt.ta.model

Class Job

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.model.Job
public class Job extends Object
A TA job posting created by a module owner (MO) and published for student applicants.

Persisted in WEB-INF/data/jobs.json through JobService. Access is via JavaBean-style getters and setters for JSON mapping. List fields (requiredSkills, schedule) may be null when loaded from sparse JSON.

Not thread-safe; the service layer serializes concurrent access to the jobs file.
